[[Blast (enchantment)|Anarchic Blast 7]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Blast (enchantment)|Anarchic Blast 7]]:''' This weapon is a chaotic conduit, dealing 7d6 Chaos damage on a successful hit, and an additional 7d6 Chaos damage on a critical hit. This effect makes the weapon chaotically aligned.
Lawful characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
